TD.ENG: ※ Holdings similar to ownership (Article 142 of the Enforcement Decree of the Financial Investment Services And Capital Markets Act) - Subparagraph 1. Where a person holds a voting right (including the power to instruct exercise of the voting right) of stocks, etc., pursuant to legal provisions, monetary trust contract, collateral agreement, or any other contracts - Subparagraph 4. Where a person holds a contractual right as prescribed in Article 5 (1) 2 of the Act to a contract for an underlying asset of stocks, etc., and acquires the status of purchaser by exercising that contractual right - Subparagraph 7. Where a person holds a stock option and acquires the status of purchaser by exercising that stock option.
